'''Chanxue''' is an NPC in {{Location|Jinzhou}}. Appears in morning next to [[Dingfeng]] in front of City Hall.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Chanxue:''' Shh, someone is coming.
:'''Chanxue:''' Hello, is there anything I can help you with?
:{{DIcon}} What's up with Lady [[Sanhua]]?
::'''Chanxue:''' ...
::'''Dingfeng:''' ...
::'''Chanxue:''' We... Well, I-I feel like Lady Sanhua is not just looking at the person when she looks at someone.
::'''Chanxue:''' How should I put it, it's like she's looking at something deeper.
::'''Chanxue:''' But the thought of this always makes me feel weird.
::'''Chanxue:''' Lady Sanhua is a good person. You can trust her with anything.
::'''Chanxue:''' Still... Please don't tell her I said this...
::'''Dingfeng:''' Hahaha, I can see that you're overthinking.
:{{DIcon}} I'm just passing by.
{{Dialogue End}}
